subject: Re: My second mapreduce job fails with java.io.FileNotFoundException

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: My second mapreduce job fails with java.io.FileNotFoundException
parts:
Hi,
if you are referring to the exception "File does not exist" it doesn't seem to affect the actual computation. It is already fixed in 2.0.1 which is imminent and you can get it from github if you know how to change branches (it is not final, but very close). The deprecation warning can be avoided if you use the pair HADOOP_CMD and HADOOP_STREAMING instead but you can safely ignore it. I hope this helps.

Antonio

On Sunday, October 28, 2012 1:05:44 AM UTC-7, tokoma1 wrote:
Hi,

I have installed rmr2 on R 2.14.1 and hadoop 1.0.3. Now I am testing the environment is correct.

The following first mapreduce job in the tutorial seemed to work.

small.ints = 1:1000
sapply(small.ints, function(x) x^2)

small.ints = to.dfs(1:1000)
mapreduce(input = small.ints, map = function(k,v) cbind(v,v^2))

The second mapreduce failed with the following error.

> groups = rbinom(32, n = 50, prob = 0.4)
